raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

 

9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com. But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.

 

These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.

 

The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).

 

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

 

This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

 
 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

  • Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

  • Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

  • Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

  • Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch

  • Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access

 

Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance

 

  • Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect

  • Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up

  • Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls

  • Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows

  • Establish feedback loops between API consumers and domain teams so that usage patterns and client requests improve the underlying data over time

 

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM

 

  • Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad

  • Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities

  • Support the shift to a solution-selling GTM motion: work with Sales and Customer Success on partner selection, POC design, technical onboarding, and commercial structuring for API deals

  • Engage directly with enterprise clients and their technical teams during pilots and integrations; this is a client-facing role, not a back-office one

  • Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs transparently to leadership, engineering, and commercial teams

  • Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

 

What We're Looking For

 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building API products, data platforms, or data distribution products at a B2B company

  • Experience designing APIs for external consumers: you have opinions on schema design, versioning strategies, rate limiting, and what makes developer documentation actually useful

  • Track record of shipping data products where you managed the full lifecycle: from defining what data to expose, through schema design, to commercial packaging and client onboarding

  • Understanding of data infrastructure concepts: data pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, data modelling, and platforms like Snowflake

  • Comfortable with SQL and Python and capable of interrogating data to validate quality, understand usage patterns, and inform product decisions

  • Experience working in a solution-selling or partner-led GTM model: you have been involved in POCs, pilots, or co-development with enterprise clients, not just self-serve product launches

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without a dedicated team: you coordinate across engineering, data, and commercial functions through influence, not authority

  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how enterprise data buyers evaluate providers, and you can shape a product that competes on data quality, coverage, and ease of integration

  • Clear communicator who can translate between technical and commercial audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or how buy-side/sell-side firms consume financial data

  • Experience with Snowflake data sharing, marketplace listings, or similar cloud data distribution mechanisms

  • Experience building entitlements, licensing, or access control systems for data products

  • Understanding of data licensing, redistribution terms, or AI usage policies in the context of enterprise data products

 

Benefits

 

  • Competitive, market-benchmarked salary

  • Pension with 7% company matching

  • Private medical insurance, paid sick leave, income protection, group life assurance

  • Season ticket and cycle-to-work schemes

  • Hybrid flexibility with up to 3 months annual work abroad

  • 25 holiday days plus local public holidays (exchangeable)

  • One-month paid sabbatical after 5 years; enhanced parental leave

  • Professional development budget and regular social events

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

Back End Engineer - Repeats

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom (At least one day in office per week)

We're looking for a back-end engineer to join the Repeats team.

You will work on the services that decide which repeat customers get a loan, at what price, and how much they can borrow. These sit at the heart of iwoca's back book.

The company

Imagine a world where every small business has the power to thrive. That's the world we're building at iwoca. Small businesses aren't just statistics – they're the heartbeat of our communities, the character of our high streets, and the engine of our economy. Since 2012, we've revolutionised how these businesses access finance, turning what was once a lengthy, frustrating process into something remarkable: funding that's fast, flexible, and actually works for modern businesses.

Our impact speaks for itself: we've provided billions in funding to over 150,000 businesses across Europe, making us one of the continent's leading fintech innovators. But we're just getting started. Our mission? To empower one million businesses with the financial tools they deserve.

We combine cutting-edge technology and data science with genuine human understanding to make finance feel less like a barrier and more like a superpower. Whether it's managing cash flow or seizing unexpected opportunities, we ensure businesses get the funds they need – often within minutes.

The team

The Repeats team is one of iwoca's funnel teams. We grow customer lifetime value after a business's first loan. That means we own the underwriting, pricing, and product experience for two segments that make up most of iwoca's back-book value: top-up customers who borrow again while still repaying, and loan-ended customers who return for a new loan. Almost every repeat borrower goes through code we own. The team is cross-functional – backend, frontend, product, design, data science and analytics – shipping behind split tests and measuring impact in Looker rather than on gut feel.

The role

Your first project will be the re-architecture of our flex-loan repeat offer pipeline: the flow that decides who is eligible for a new loan, what they pay, and how much they can borrow. This area has been under-invested for years. Once the new pipeline is in place, product has a clear runway of features ready to ship on top of it.

You will own backend features end-to-end, from design through to shipping and monitoring them in production. Over time, you will pick up front-end work and grow into a full-stack role.

Impact on customers

  • Work on the systems that shape every repeat customer's offer, and move the metrics behind iwoca's back-book performance.

  • Ship features that make it faster and clearer for small business owners to access follow-on funding.

Ownership and delivery

  • Work through the full development lifecycle – from technical design and implementation to rollout behind a split test – on well-defined components.

  • Maintain and support the core services behind repeat lending: the lending_decision app inside iwoca-django, the repeats pricing and offer-amount services, and the customer account pages.

  • Help monitor production and troubleshoot issues when they come up.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, Data Science and Analytics to build solutions that make sense technically and land well for customers.

  • Show up to team rituals – stand-ups, retros, planning – with context and questions.

  • Write clean, well-tested Python, and take part in code reviews to learn from teammates and keep quality high.

  • Pick up front-end work in Pandora (React, TypeScript) so you can own features end-to-end over time.

The requirements

Essential

  • Comfortable writing clear, testable Python. You do not need to be an expert.

  • 1+ years of commercial engineering experience.

  • Working knowledge of relational databases. We use PostgreSQL.

  • Curious about the full stack and up for picking up front end (React, TypeScript) over time.

raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs spends meaningfully on paid acquisition, and that spend is only as good as the data behind it. We are looking for an engineer to own our measurement layer end to end: the tag manager setup, the tracking and attribution scripts on our sites, and the server-to-server conversion tracking that feeds our ad platforms.

Day to day you will work closely with the paid marketing team: fixing tracking bugs as they come in, setting up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debugging discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data. Longer term, you will define how tracking should properly work here and build the monitoring so we catch breakage in hours, not weeks.

This role sits between frontend engineering, data engineering, and marketing. You will add and improve tracking scripts without hurting pagespeed, keep our server-side GTM container healthy, make sure consent and regional restrictions are correctly enforced, and ensure the right channels get credit for the right conversions. Your work directly decides how a large paid budget gets allocated.

What you will do

  • Own our tag manager setup end to end, including the server-side GTM container, and review any changes other teams want to make

  • Work with the paid marketing team daily: fix tracking bugs, set up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debug discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data

  • Build and maintain server-to-server conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, and similar) and validate pixel vs server deduplication

  • Improve tracking script performance and correctness, keeping script impact on pagespeed and Core Web Vitals within budget

  • Make sure consent handling and regional restrictions are correctly enforced across markets

  • Define event schema and UTM conventions, and document them so tracking for new campaigns is correct by default

  • Build monitoring and alerting for the measurement stack so we catch broken tracking within hours, not weeks

  • Review PRs that add conversion events to the main app, and work with product engineering on tracking integrations

Requirements

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, comfortable working in both frontend code and a production application codebase

  • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server-side GTM, and at least one conversion API (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or similar) implemented server-to-server

  • Experience debugging attribution discrepancies end to end: pixel vs server deduplication, UTM conventions, event schema design

  • Solid understanding of web performance and how to add tracking without degrading Core Web Vitals

  • Working knowledge of consent and privacy requirements (Consent Mode v2, regional restrictions) and SQL for validating tracking data in the warehouse

Bonus

  • CDP experience (Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow)

  • Product analytics tools (GA4, Amplitude, PostHog) and dbt

  • Next.js experience

  • Exposure to incrementality testing or media mix modelling

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own the whole martech and measurement area as it grows, potentially leading a small marketing engineering team

  • Grow toward senior/staff IC on the engineering track

  • Broaden into data engineering and attribution modelling, or into growth engineering more widely (experimentation, landing page infrastructure)

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

raw.title: Founding Growth Lead
raw.description:
About the job

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

 

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. Your role here isn't just to hit a number, it's to help redefine how an entire market discovers what's possible, and to build the commercial engine that gets us there.

Founded in 2024, we've already gained the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others.

Our early traction enabled us to raise £2.6m in funding and we're now looking to scale faster. We're moving from founder-led sales to a repeatable growth engine and we want someone who has built that engine before, not someone building it for the first time.

 

The Basics

📍 Location: London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

⏱️ Experience: 4+ years in outbound-heavy sales/GTM, including time spent building process, tooling, or a team from scratch

🧑‍💼 Reports to: Founders

💰 Pay: Competitive base with uncapped, meaningful upside plus equity

🥇 The role: Lead our commercial engine, own pipeline generation, close new business, and build the playbooks, tooling, and team structure that let us scale beyond founder-led sales

 

The Role

This is the role that builds and runs Adclear's UK commercial engine. We spent two years building a genuine community, a content engine, events and a strong network a lot of what you touch is already warm. But we need someone who's done more than work a warm desk: someone who has stood up a GTM motion before, knows what "repeatable" actually looks like, and can operate directly with founders without a playbook handed to them.

You'll close net-new business yourself, own the full cycle from outbound through to signed retainer, and build the systems - CRM, sequencing, reporting that let the function scale past you. As we grow, you'll be first in line to build and lead the team underneath this role.

You'll sell with the best growth tooling available. We invest in the stack so your time goes where it counts: in front of prospects and building the machine. We use Attio as our CRM, Clay for rev ops, Sales Nav for prospecting, Lemlist for outreach and we're building a fully AI-enabled stack that automates the busywork.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the full GTM cycle end-to-end: ICP definition, outbound, discovery, pilot, close, and retainer conversion

  • Build and own the CRM, sequencing infrastructure, content-to-pipeline flow, and commercial playbook from the ground up

  • Run daily outbound across calls, email and LinkedIn, with phone/in-person meetings as your first move, not your last resort

  • Work our warm engine - content, events, podcast and community leads and convert events into pipeline yourself

  • Check inbound signals daily (website visits, demo sign-ups, content downloads) and act on what matters

  • Partner directly with the founders on pricing, positioning, and GTM strategy

  • Start building the hiring plan and playbook for the team you'll lead as the function scales

  • Report on pipeline health, conversion, and what's working well enough to double down on

 

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • You've closed net-new business personally and can point to a repeatable process behind it

  • You've built (or meaningfully upgraded) the CRM, sequencing, and reporting infrastructure the team runs on

  • You're operating with high autonomy and are trusted to make GTM strategy calls with the founders

  • You've made the case for, and started building, the team underneath you

 

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years in outbound-heavy sales or GTM, with a track record of building not just executing, process, tooling, or a team

  • Demonstrated ownership of a full commercial cycle: prospecting through close, ideally including team leadership or cross-functional GTM strategy work

  • Phone-first and comfortable in person you don't hide behind email and LinkedIn

  • Evidence of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in a scaling environment, with numbers to back it up

  • Genuine self-starter who's operated with minimal playbook before and built one from scratch

  • Sharp enough to hold a real conversation about a technical, regulated product without needing to be an expert on day one

  • Comfortable reporting directly to founders and operating with significant autonomy

 

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience selling into regulated industries: fintech, legaltech, or healthtech

  • Experience building or scaling an outbound or broker/referral channel from zero

  • Prior experience as a founding or early commercial hire at a startup

  • Direct experience owning or building CRM/rev-ops infrastructure

  • An established personal presence or content instinct on LinkedIn

 

How We Work

  • Founders are closely involved in the day-to-day

  • No rigid script: you test, learn and adapt on your own initiative

  • You own your pipeline end-to-end, including follow-through after a meeting is booked

  • The pace is fast and the approach is still being built you're one of the people building it

  • This isn't the right role if you want a fixed formula handed to you on day one

 

Benefits

  • Meaningful equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware budget

  • Monthly gym contribution

  • Direct path to building and leading the commercial team as we scale
